The retrieved context doesn't include the LlamaIndex starter example, so I can't say for certain which call it uses. The closest match is the persistence guide, which shows the general pattern:

"storage_context.persist(persist_dir="<persist_dir>")" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/storing/save_load.md]

It also says the default directory is:

"This will persist data to disk, under the specified `persist_dir` (or `./storage` by default)." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/storing/save_load.md]

So if the starter example calls `storage_context.persist()` without an argument, it would save to `./storage`. If it passes a `persist_dir`, that value is the directory name. Please check the starter example's source to confirm.
